Subject: ClearHorizon MAP: finalization & security checklist

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. As promised, I attached our working MAP (Redwood-MAP-v3.pdf) and sketched a proposed close cadence so legal/procurement can bake this into their schedule. High level ask from your side was: SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA redline, and confirmation of data retention/residency.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange SOC 2 summary + SIG responses + DPA template (we've attached).
- Week 1–2: POC kickoff (limited scope, shared test dataset) + evidence intake.
- Week 3: Security review signoff (SOC2 + SIG Q&A) + finalize DPA redline.
- Week 4: Contract signature and production enablement (target close).

Target close date: 2026-12-17 (flexible if you need more review time).

Quick answers up front to common asks:
- SOC 2: we can provide the latest Type II report and a short one-page controls summary.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a CAIQ mapping; we can export the filled responses as a spreadsheet.
- DPA: we will send our standard DPA and are happy to review reasonable redlines.
- Data retention: standard defaults are logs 90 days, backups 365 days; options exist for custom retention and EU residency via our Private deployment.

Please confirm the procurement/legal contacts and any hard dates you have for the POC or procurement windows so we can lock resources on our side.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min sync if that's easiest.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0182

Tessa —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few items from procurement/legal to surface so we align expectations:

1) Procurement windows: our Q4 procurement window closes 2026-11-30 for any vendors needing Finance approval this quarter. If Redwood needs PO terms locked this quarter, we need an indicative commercial by 11/26. Otherwise, the next window opens mid-Jan.

2) SOC2: please send the latest Type II and a succinct controls summary (PII, encryption, incident response).

3) SIG/CAIQ: we need a row-level spreadsheet of your CAIQ responses and any high-risk exceptions flagged (we'll share with our security team).

4) DPA: Legal needs your standard DPA for redline; highlight any non-negotiable clauses (subprocessor, liability caps, deletion timelines).

5) Data retention/residency: clarify default retention and whether we can set a shorter retention window for the POC dataset. Also need list of subprocessors and whether logs/backups can be restricted to US-only.

6) POC scope: 4-week POC preferred (2 weeks integration + 2 weeks production-like runs). We will provide a synthetic test set for the first two weeks.

I've attached the procurement timeline our team uses so you can see the slotted dates.

Can Ben or Kimberly coordinate the security evidence delivery?

Thanks,
Emma Thompson
Head of Cloud Procurement, ClearHorizon Bank
Attaching: procurement_timeline.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Thompson <emma.thompson@clearhorizon.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ClearHorizon MAP: finalization & security checklist

Emma — thanks for the notes and the timeline. Looping in explicit answers and attachments to speed legal/security review.

Quick answers (summary):
- SOC 2: attaching SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted Type II summary) — includes controls scope, test period, and relevant control narratives (access control, encryption, monitoring, incident response). Full report available under NDA; we can provide via a secure portal.

- SIG/CAIQ: attaching SIG-responses.xlsx (full CAIQ export) with a top-left tab called HIGH-RISK where we flag items requiring discussion (primarily around data residency for backups and a small set of subprocessor specifics).

- DPA: attaching DPA-template.docx — our standard DPA. Key notes:
  • Subprocessors: we publish a current list and will provide the live list; major cloud infra subprocessors are called out in section 4.
  • Liability / caps: our commercial team prefers to handle caps in the SOW; DPA contains standard mutual-clauses.
  • Deletion timelines: we support customer-requested deletion; primary workspace data is deleted within 30 days of termination; backups are rotated and retained up to 365 days by default (we can scope a shorter backup retention for POC).

- Data residency: production workloads can be pinned to US regions. For EU residency we suggest Redwood Private. For the POC, we can host the test dataset in a US region and enforce a 30-day retention window for POC-specific artifacts.

Proposed MAP milestone adjustments (concrete dates based on your procurement window):
- 11/16: SOC2-summary + SIG-responses + DPA-template delivered (today/tomorrow cadence).
- 11/17–11/30: POC onboarding & integration (we can swap in a 2-week mini-POC if procurement needs Q4 slotting).
- 12/06: Security signoff target (exceptions loop closed).
- 12/13: Final commercial & DPA redline agreed.
- 12/17: Contract signature and production enablement (target).

Attachments included: SOC2-summary.pdf, SIG-responses.xlsx, DPA-template.docx.

On subprocessors: the short list includes our managed inference infra partner and a monitoring provider; I'll provide the full list via the portal and mark any that have EU residency options.

If Legal wants a tracked-copy redline, Kimberly, could your team own the DPA review and call out anything they mark as high priority? I'll run the SIG questions in parallel with our security team.

Happy to join a call next week — available 11/16 or 11/17 PST.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (650) 555-0147

Thanks — I will own the DPA review with your legal team and track redlines in a shared DocuSign-friendly file. Proposed weekly stand: Tuesdays 09:00 PT starting 11/17 to keep the MAP moving.
